description: Semantic WPF UI Title Bar block for compact application identity and trailing commands. Balance icon, title scale, search width, and actions against the measured desktop width instead of letting one region visually erase the others.

height.description: Rendered height of the Title Bar in device-independent pixels.

fontSize.description: Font size of the compact application title in device-independent pixels.

padding.description: Inner spacing around Title Bar content, using WPF Thickness syntax.

title.description: Application title displayed in the Title Bar.

centerContent.description: Optional content rendered in the Title Bar's native flexible center region. Prefer this for a centered search or command surface instead of compensating with asymmetric Title Bar padding.

header.description: Optional custom identity content rendered beside the icon. Use this when icon, title, or supporting identity need explicit composition; omit it to keep the native title text.

actions.description: Search and action controls rendered horizontally in the trailing content region.

icon.description: Optional Symbol Icon rendered before the title.
